title: Optional Digital-Comic Audio Cue Lane
objective: Bind AAI resources/cues to pages, panels and transitions for optional digital presentation only while keeping audio nonblocking and preventing embedding/export unless independent rights allow it.
acceptance: Audio cue bindings preserve stable SAA project/page/panel or transition target identity and stable external AAI resource/cue identity.
AAI remains authoritative for audio source/resource identity, cue semantics, playback/layering and audio preparation; SAA stores presentation bindings only.
Audio remains optional and nonblocking: absence or unavailability of optional audio cannot invalidate the visual comic project, static reading order or SAA-15 visual export baseline.
Available audio references preserve explicit version, availability and compatibility state and fail binding/playback preparation closed when stale, missing, revoked or incompatible.
Embedding or export of bound audio is prohibited unless independent ARI/AAI rights evidence explicitly allows the required capability; permission is never inferred from binding or availability.
Provider-off visual comic operation remains supported and SAA performs no synthesis, provider calls or canonical AAI mutation.
SAA-17 and later accessibility/package/share/publication/SMB10B behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-16 owns optional SAA presentation bindings to existing AAI resources/cues only; AAI retains audio identity, semantics, playback and preparation authority.
Audio is a late-bind optional lane and may not become a prerequisite for visual authoring, visual reading or SAA-15 static export.
No audio synthesis, source mutation, rights fabrication, automatic embedding/export, sharing/publication or final Creator integration authority is granted.
SAA-17 remains blocked until verified SAA-16 closeout.
next_action: Establish causal RED for optional nonblocking SAA presentation bindings to external AAI resources/cues with explicit version/availability/compatibility and independent rights-gated embed/export; then implement only SAA-16.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner Continue governed-started SAA-16 after verified SAA-15 closeout.
